name: Kazuhara Iku
source:
"I've got coffee flowing through me instead of blood, that's why."

Likes: His family's coffee

A good-looking boy who is the leader of the "Childhood Friend Corps". He was born into a family that runs a coffee shop. After school, he always wears a sommelier's outfit and devotes himself to his work.

As a child, he was everyone's leader, but after receiving a magic coffee maker from [url=/c125616]Eliska[/url], he became absorbed in his family business. Now he settles everything with coffee, becoming a genuine coffee shop freak.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://hulotte.jp/product/vision/character/iku.html]official website[/url]]
